title: Vue Router
description: The official router for Vue.js applications.

data.text: Vue Router is the official router for Vue.js. It integrates deeply with Vue and allows building single-page applications with nested routes, route parameters, query support, and navigation guards.

data.title: Defining Routes
data.content: Set up routes with Vue Router 4.

terms.definition: Vue Router uses the browser's History API for clean URLs without hash fragments.
Functions that guard route transitions, useful for auth and redirects.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Vue Router integrates deeply with Vue's reactivity system
Supports nested routes and route guards
Lazy-loaded route components for better performance
data.takeaway: Vue Router provides a complete routing solution for Vue applications.
